haiku.problem: The question says the wife was loved by "another man," but the verses say only "loved by another." The word "man" adds a detail the lesson doesn't give.
The question asks how he will "get her back," and the right answer is "He bought her back." The word "back" nearly gives away the answer, which the rules forbid.
"After many days" is unclear when asked at random. The question should name what the many days are, such as the days without king or prince, so it makes sense without the lesson.
